scripts.dev:server: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/run-with-env.mjs go -C server run github.com/air-verse/air@v1.67.4 -c .air.toml
scripts.generate:web-client: pnpm --dir web openapi && pnpm run generate:proto-constants
scripts.migrate:server: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/run-with-env.mjs go -C server run ./cmd/migrate -dir migrations
scripts.migrate:dev: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/run-with-env.mjs go -C server run ./cmd/migrate -dir migrations -allow-checksum-repair
scripts.sync:all: pnpm run sync:shipping-lines && pnpm run sync:unlocode && pnpm run sync:airlines && pnpm run sync:airports && pnpm run sync:regions
scripts.acceptance:finance: pnpm run acceptance:finance-bill-batch -- --apply && pnpm run acceptance:finance-payable -- --apply && pnpm run acceptance:finance-ui
scripts.check:web: pnpm run check:permission-keys && pnpm run check:proto-constants && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run test:duplicates:web && pnpm --dir web lint && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.check:server: pnpm run test:duplicates:go && pnpm run check:layers:go && pnpm run lint:proto && go -C server test -p 32 ./... && go -C server vet ./... && pnpm run check:server:vuln
scripts.check: pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:server
scripts.build:web: pnpm run check:permission-keys && pnpm run check:proto-constants && pnpm --dir web build && node scripts/upload-sentry-sourcemaps.mjs && node scripts/stage-web-assets.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server
scripts.check:layers:go: go -C scripts/layer-check-go test ./... && go -C scripts/layer-check-go run .
